text:
zach: Heads-up — thinking about simplifying the console query data path surface to reduce RBAC coupling and speed up tenant requests. Current model is gateway -> projection -> render, and each layer does permission lookups. We're seeing duplicate DB reads and some long-tail latency spikes.

lina: Strong +1 on reducing auth hops. Can you sketch the proposed surface?

zach: Proposal: do a single access check at the gateway and mint a short-lived signed context token that downstream services (projection/render) can verify and trust. Downstreams skip perm DB lookups and only enforce row-level filters using claims in the token. Benefits: fewer DB reads, much higher cache hit rate, simpler tracing. Drawbacks: tighter trust boundaries and rollout complexity.

martin: Quick concern — projection still needs tenant-scoped filtering and sometimes attribute-based decisions (org vs user rights). If gateway bakes the decision into token, how do we keep ABAC semantics?

zach: Token includes principal id, org id, and a small set of granted roles/flags. Projection enforces row filters by org id and uses the roles for feature gating, but it doesn't re-run full perm resolution. Gateway still runs the heavy ABAC evaluation when minting token and caches policy results.

sasha: Revocation? If an admin revokes a role mid-flight, how do we stop requests bearing a recently minted token?

lina: Mitigation: very short TTL (e.g., `30s`) + revocation list checked at gateway when minting. For immediate revoke, push a deny flag to gateway config which prevents new tokens; existing tokens expire quickly.

martin: Any perf numbers to justify this?

zach: Local staging run: removing projection-level perm DB call reduced p50 from ~38ms to ~26ms and p99 from ~210ms to ~150ms for tenant-heavy paths. Token sign/verify cost is ~0.5ms. Token cache hit on gateway was ~97% in the sim.

ops-bot: Perf test job finished — run 4521 (2026-03-12). Results: https://perf.internal/runs/4521 :white_check_mark:

sasha: Rollout suggestion: start read-only routes first. Gateway mints tokens for read APIs only; projection accepts token but stays in shadow-check mode where it still does DB lookups and compares outcomes. Run for 2 weeks.

lina: We'll also need audit logs: projection should log token id + resolved principal + decision for compliance. That way we can prove what the gateway issued vs what projection enforced.

martin: Cross-region fanout note: tokens must be verifiable without contacting gateway. Use KMS-signed JWTs or HMAC with shared keys; ensure key rotation strategy.

zach: Plan: KMS-signed JWTs, services cache verification keys for 1h, rotate keys monthly. Add a key-publish webhook so services get new keys before rotation.

sasha: Action items: zach -> draft RFC w/ sequence diagrams and rollout checklist; lina -> audit logging requirements; martin -> prototype verifier lib (node + go); sasha -> run canary perf tests and validate p99 tail.

zach: I'll drop the RFC by EOW and link it here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
